note: Bangladesh Bank's Credit Information Bureau (CIB), read in its own circulars on bb.org.bd. CIB Circular Letter No. 01 of 5 March 2025 (Bangla, scanned, read by eye) has every bank and finance company upload all its borrowers' credit information monthly, by the 15th of the following month, with no threshold stated: written as reported 30 days after the due date (a monthly cycle). CIB Circular No. 1/2021 of 16 June 2021 (Bangla, its text layer in a legacy font that doesn't extract, read by eye) has the CIB report's 'All Loan' option show a customer's living loans, terminated loans up to six years after termination and requested loans up to two years, and the contracts' credit history downloadable for 12 or 24 months: the game uses the 24 months of history the report shows, as keep two years (as Djibouti's file uses the two years its reports show); a terminated loan's entry stays six years after termination, which the form doesn't hold. Bangladesh Bank's circular list (read 2026-10-30) lists no later circular changing either option.

sources.said: “All Loan” অপশন হতে ডাউনলোডকৃত সিআইবি রিপোর্টে একজন গ্রাহকের Living loan, Terminated loan (Terminate হওয়ার পর ৬ ছয় বছর পর্যন্ত) এবং সকল Requested Loan (Request করার পর ০২ (দুই) বছর পর্যন্ত)এর সংশ্লিষ্ট তথ্য সমূহ অন্তর্ভুক্ত থাকবে। ... “All Loan” ও “Only Living Loan” অপশন হতে ডাউনলোডকৃত সিআইবি রিপোর্টের contract সমূহের ক্রেডিট হিস্ট্রি ১২ মাস এবং ২৪ মাস দুইটি অপশনেই Download করার ব্যবস্থা থাকবে।
